subject: Weekly MAP pulse: Trial acceptance gap sprint & contingency commitments
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@acmehealth.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly MAP pulse: Trial acceptance gap sprint & contingency commitments

Hi Sara / Tom —

Quick weekly pulse on the MAP for the Acme trial. High-level: core integration and eval tests are on track, but there are three acceptance gaps we should close this week to keep the planned close timeline. I captured the current MAP in the attached MAP_v1.xlsx and a focused trial-eval-checklist.pdf.

Open acceptance gaps (owners suggested):
- Data ingress validation (owner: Acme) — test vectors from production subset need to be shared; ETA Thu 6/17.
- Security evidence (owner: Redwood, primary: Marissa) — we can provide SOC-related artifact summaries but need confirmation on scope (API logs vs full audit trails).
- Latency SLO validation (owner: Engineering — Jordan) — target is 300ms p95; current pipeline shows 350–420ms in some tails.

Proposed sprint actions this week:
1) Share the trimmed production sample (Sara) — due: Thu 6/17.
2) Redwood provides Security Evidence Summary and a short mitigation plan (Marissa) — due: Wed 6/16.
3) Engineering to run focused perf pass with quantization profile Q2 and share metrics (Jordan) — due: Fri 6/18.
4) Quick sync to confirm final acceptance criteria and sign-off route — propose Wed 6/16 @ 11:00 PT (30m).

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (worksheet: milestones), trial-eval-checklist.pdf

If that timeline works, I will lock the meeting and mark the MAP items as active. If you prefer a different owner for any item, flag it and we'll update.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@acmehealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 12:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP pulse: Trial acceptance gap sprint & contingency commitments

Karthik — thanks for the tidy summary. A couple notes from Acme: we can own the data ingress validation but need a smaller anonymized slice (PII removed) — I'll confirm the tokenization steps with our data team and send by Thu 6/17 EOD.

Two potential blockers to flag now:
- Our security/compliance gate requires evidence that API request/response payloads are not stored beyond 30 days. We need Redwood to confirm retention behavior and provide sample audit logs.
- The 300ms p95 target is aggressive for our current region; if your perf pass can't hit that, we need a documented fallback (e.g., smaller model variant or caching path) so our infra team can sign-off.

Wed 6/16 11:00 PT works for a sync. Can you add a calendar invite?

—Sara
Sara Gomez
Sr. Director, Data Platforms, Acme Health
sara.gomez@acmehealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP pulse: Trial acceptance gap sprint & contingency commitments

On Mon, Jun 14, 2027 at 09:05 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick weekly pulse on the MAP for the Acme trial. High-level: core integration and eval tests are on track...

Folks — I pulled together a short security-evidence-summary.xlsx (attached) that maps common SOC items to the artifacts we can provide immediately. Quick notes:
- Retention: by default API telemetry is retained for 90 days in hosted; for trials we can provide an extract of the last 30 days scoped to Acme's tenant as an artifact.
- Audit logs: we can generate a redacted log sample for the endpoints in question; I will need a list of the exact endpoints from Sara (data ingress + inference endpoints).

Action owners (confirmed internally):
- Security evidence and redacted audit logs: Marissa Cole (deliverable Wed 6/16 4pm PT)
- Perf pass & small-variant baseline: Jordan Blake (deliverable Fri 6/18 COB)
- MAP updates & communications: Karthik Iyer (I'll help with the invite + status board)

Contingency plan if perf deviates from 300ms p95:
- Immediate fallback: enable local prefix caching on the busiest route and test smaller model variant (gpt-mini-quant).
- If still above target, propose a capacity/burst window for customer UAT to accommodate tails while we optimize.

I will attach the security spreadsheet in the Wednesday email and bring the artifacts to the sync.

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Security, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sara Gomez <sara.gomez@acmehealth.com>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Weekly MAP pulse: Trial acceptance gap sprint & contingency commitments

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for the notes earlier in the week. Quick update after the sync and internal work:

Status summary:
- Data sample: Sara confirmed tokenization approach and sent the anonymized sample on Thu 6/17 — we ingested and validated.
- Security artifacts: attached security-evidence-summary.xlsx (worksheet: extract) and a redacted audit sample. Marissa delivered Wednesday afternoon.
- Perf baseline: Jordan ran the focused pass with quant profile Q2; attached trial-eval-checklist.pdf includes the perf table — p95 sits at 295ms on the tuned path when prefix caching is enabled; un-tuned tails still hit ~380ms in worst case.

Committed next steps (owners & due dates):
- Final acceptance sign-off doc (owner: Sara) — due Tue 6/22 EOD.
- If sign-off requires stricter SLA, we'll prepare a short statement of work for a Dedicated burst window (owner: Karthik) — draft due Thu 6/24.
- Engineering refinement to reduce perf tails (owner: Jordan) — ongoing, checkpoint Mon 6/21.

Meeting: I put a 30-minute sync on Wed 6/16 but we extended notes into the running MAP board. If you'd like a follow-up to walk through the artifacts, suggest Mon 6/21 @ 10:00 PT.

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), trial-eval-checklist.pdf, security-evidence-summary.xlsx

Appreciate the partnership — we should be in a good position to close once Sara confirms acceptance doc.

Best,
